## What's free

Community plan: 5 active connected nodes, 1 custom dashboard per room; personal, non-commercial use only

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://www.netdata.cloud/pricing/> before relying on this.

## Notes

The open-source Netdata agent runs on each host; containers on a monitored host don't count as nodes. The unlimited-nodes Community plan was retired in 2024.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
